pages.title: The Engine Will Last
pages.text: Keep your own siege engine working through real repair after damage.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Native repair uses iron nuggets and planks. Catapult movement aims, right-click previews trajectory and Space loads/fires; ballista has right-click precision aiming. Check remapped controls.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Repair a damaged machine using nuggets and planks; clicking a full-health engine is not repair.
